subject: Automotive & EVs
title: Car Sharing and Micro-Mobility
description: One-minute skill: Car Sharing and Micro-Mobility.

hook.text: One shared car can replace up to 13 privately owned vehicles—if people are willing to share.

buildup.text: Car-sharing services like Zipcar let urban residents rent a car by the hour without owning one.

discovery.text: E-scooters and bike-sharing filled the last-mile gap, connecting train stations to homes cheaply.

twist.text: Cities banned and unbanned scooters repeatedly, struggling with sidewalk clutter and rider safety.

climax.text: When sharing and micro-mobility combine well, they reduce car trips, parking demand, and emissions.

punchline.text: Sharing a ride and riding a scooter chip away at car culture.

quiz.question: How many privately owned cars can one shared car potentially replace?
